Subject: Deployment mode qualification — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (SSO, KMS/HSM, logging)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on deployment constraints and which Redwood offering fits best.

Quick recap of what I heard during the discovery:
- SSO: Okta SAML2 required; SCIM provisioning preferred for user provisioning/SCIM groups.
- Key management: customer-managed keys + HSM-backed key material is a hard requirement for production PII workflows.
- Logging and retention: audit logs and request/response logs need to be retained for 5+ years and forwarded to your Splunk instance (and filtered for PII).
- Data residency: US-only; model hosting in us-east-1 preferred.

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm SCIM is required or just desirable?
2) Do you need full request/response export (raw tokens) or only metadata/audit trails tied to request IDs?
3) Who should we invite from your infra/security for a detailed architecture workshop?

How Redwood maps to your needs (high level):
- Hosted API: fastest to go-live, supports Okta SAML for admin login, but does NOT support customer-managed KMS/HSM or sending raw request/response logs to customer-owned Splunk out-of-the-box.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): supports stronger network isolation and can support streaming audit logs and BYOK in some architectures; limited HSM integrations depending on deployment model.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): supports full control (customer-managed KMS, HSM, network isolation, long-term log retention under your control) — recommended if HSM + long-term raw-logs are mandatory.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa (SE) + Monica (ops) to run a security design workshop with your security/infra team (30–45m).
- Share SOC2 and SSO/KMS integration docs (attached).
- We’ll prepare a focused SOW for Dedicated vs Private options with estimated cost delta.

Available times for the workshop: Tue 3/23 10–12 PT or Thu 3/25 2–4 PT. Please pick a slot and the right technical contacts.

Thanks — Dylan

--

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SCIM: required. We want automated provisioning/deprovisioning (Okta SCIM connector) and group sync.
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed KMS is required. We currently use AWS KMS with external key material (EKM) backed by an HSM. If you can support BYOK via a customer KMS export to your environment or a connector to our HSM, that would be ideal.
- Logs: we need audit logs and request metadata sent to our Splunk collector (HTTPS/Syslog). For regulatory reasons we may need full request/response exports for specific workflows; can discuss scoping in the workshop. Retention target: 5 years.

Attaching our security handbook excerpt for context (see section on keys & logging). For the workshop please include your security engineer and an SE who can talk KMS/HSM integration patterns.

We can do Tue 3/23 10:30 PT. Inviting our infra lead (Priya) and our security architect (samir.chaudhry@fintechco.com) — I’ll send the calendar invite after you confirm.

Thanks — Alex

Hi Alex — thanks for the detail. Quick note from an SE/ops perspective to set expectations and make the workshop productive.

High-level mapping and recommended approach:

1) Hosted API
- SSO: Redwood Hosted supports SAML SSO for admin console access (Okta). We do not currently support SCIM provisioning from Hosted tenants.
- KMS/HSM: Hosted cannot accept customer-managed KMS/EKM or connect to external HSMs — keys are managed by Redwood.
- Logging: Hosted provides audit metadata (who/what/when) and aggregated usage logs; we cannot routinely export raw request/response payloads to customer Splunk for Hosted customers due to multi-tenant constraints.
- Recommendation: Hosted is great for evals and non-PII production, but not suitable if BYOK/HSM or raw-log export are mandatory.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity)
- SSO: Dedicated supports SAML SSO and we can implement SCIM in many Dedicated deployments (we’ll need to confirm per-customer config).
- KMS/HSM: Dedicated supports BYOK via customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) in the dedicated network model; HSM/EKM support is possible in some deployments via cross-account integrations or customer-managed KMS in VPC. We’ll need to confirm the exact HSM product and whether you require FIPS-level HSM attestation.
- Logging: We can stream audit logs and request metadata to your Splunk collector; exporting full request/response is possible in Dedicated but requires additional guardrails (PII filtering, retention controls, encryption at rest) and is covered in the SOW.
- Recommendation: Dedicated is the starting point if you want low operational overhead with most security controls; it may meet your needs if your HSM/KMS pattern maps to our BYOK options.

3) Private (VPC / on-prem)
- SSO: Full support for SAML + SCIM (we can run the SCIM service in your VPC).
- KMS/HSM: Full support for customer-managed KMS and HSMs — private deployments can be configured to use your KMS/EKM or integrate with on-prem HSMs.
- Logging: You control log ingestion and retention (splunk/syslog), and we can ship raw logs into your environment with the retention you require.
- Recommendation: Choose Private if HSM/EKM and long-term raw-log retention are non-negotiable.

Proposed agenda for the workshop (30–45m):
- 5m goals & constraints (FintechCo)
- 15m Redwood deployment options & integration patterns (Marissa)
- 15m deep-dive on KMS/HSM and logging (Monica)
- 5–10m next steps / SOW checklist

Pre-reads attached: Redwood_SSO_SCIM_matrix.pdf (what we currently support), SOC2_Ops_Overview.pdf. Please share any network diagrams or HSM vendor details ahead of the call (e.g., Thales/CloudHSM).

We’ll prepare two short runbooks for the workshop: Dedicated + BYOK pattern and Private/VPC + HSM pattern. See you Tue 3/23 10:30 PT. I’ll add a calendar invite and include our security engineer.

Best — Marissa
